title: Luotain2 Gate IV-002 frozen blind support discovery
model: Discrete-time linear shift terms; original FFT proposal plus declared local stencil challenger; disjoint-time IV fit; known 1% sensor noise; corrected held-out risk; no oracle terms

controls.test: independent noisy trajectory; true term support shown only after prediction

pilot.note: Development data; tuning happened between pilots

failure_examples.wormhole_measurement: Across 5 seeds recovered around +1.77 u[t-1] -0.79 u[t-2] + small false lag-two shift, omitted true remote (+17,-9)
failure_examples.diagonal_measurement: Across 5 seeds selected lag-two oblique substitutes and omitted true cardinal neighbors
failure_examples.combined_wave_extra_term: One of two tests selected a spurious lag-one diagonal shift

limitations: Known 1% sensor noise level supplied; not fully blind to sensor model
Only linear shift family; nonlinear original Luotain2 worlds excluded
Local four-neighbor proposals given explicitly, weakening novelty claim on local worlds
Original 35 non-null benchmark not directly comparable
All fields from same synthetic generator; no real sensor evaluation
Process excitation hypothesis not yet causal confirmation
